<!--StartFragment-->

<p>We, the parents of Manasvi Sharma (Class VIII), are grateful to be a part of the Delhi Public School, Saharanpur family. Over the years, we have seen a remarkable improvement in her academics, confidence, and overall personality.

Manasvi has always been sincere in her studies, and her teachers’ constant support and approachable guidance have helped her progress steadily. We truly appreciate the encouragement she receives not only in academics but also in extracurricular activities. Her involvement in public speaking, dance, and art has significantly boosted her confidence and shaped her communication skills.

We are thankful to the teachers, coordinators, and the entire DPS Saharanpur team for nurturing her growth with such patience, positivity, and care. We look forward to seeing her continue to learn, explore, and achieve new milestones under your guidance.</p>

<!--StartFragment-->

<p>We are grateful to DPS Saharanpur for the remarkable growth we’ve seen in
Avyaan over the years. From a quiet and curious child, he has developed into a
confident and responsible student, thanks to the school’s nurturing and positive
environment.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p data-start="290" data-end="626">This year, we have seen him balance academics
with his interests in sports and quizzes with sincerity and enthusiasm. His
teachers have supported him with patience and encouragement, especially in
subjects where he needed extra confidence. Their guidance has strengthened his
understanding and boosted both his learning and self-belief.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p data-start="628" data-end="887">We truly appreciate the role the school and
teachers have played in shaping his discipline, focus, and overall personality.
We are proud of his progress and thankful to DPS Saharanpur for providing a
space where he can learn, grow, and discover his potential.<o:p></o:p></p>

<!--StartFragment-->

<p>As the parent of Agrima Rana (Class IX), I would like to express my
gratitude to DPS Saharanpur for its role in her academic and personal growth.
The school’s emphasis on discipline, values, and holistic learning has helped
her become more confident, responsible, and goal-oriented.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p data-start="317" data-end="470">I sincerely appreciate the teachers for their
constant guidance and encouragement, which have strengthened her skills and
supported her overall progress.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p data-start="472" data-end="597">Thank you, DPS Saharanpur, for providing an
environment that inspires learning and builds a strong foundation for the
future.<o:p></o:p></p>

Fostering Growth Through Sports at DPS  Saharanpur

At Delhi Public School, Saharanpur, we view sports as an essential pillar of education—one that nurtures not only physical health but also emotional strength and character. Our sports program is designed to complement academic learning, offering students a well-rounded developmental experience.

We emphasize a balanced approach to education, where physical activity plays a key role in shaping confident, disciplined, and motivated individuals. Participation in sports teaches students important life lessons—how to work as a team, handle success and failure with grace, stay committed to goals, and push through challenges with resilience.

Students at DPS Saharanpur have access to a broad spectrum of sports including cricket, football, basketball, athletics, badminton, table tennis, swimming, and yoga. Our campus features well-equipped sports facilities, guided by experienced coaches who mentor students to improve their skills and discover their potential. Many of our young athletes have proudly represented the school at various inter-school, district, and state-level events.

Beyond formal training, we create numerous opportunities for students to engage in physical activities—through inter-house competitions, morning fitness drills, and our much-anticipated Annual Sports Meet. These events encourage friendly competition, sportsmanship, and self-confidence.

We firmly believe that involvement in sports contributes significantly to students' academic performance, emotional well-being, and leadership abilities. By promoting an active lifestyle from an early age, DPS Saharanpur prepares its students to lead healthy, balanced, and purposeful lives.

At DPS Saharanpur, sports are not just extracurricular—they are a powerful medium through which we inspire holistic development and lifelong excellence.

sections.content_heading: Celebrating Excellence

columns.title: Celebrating Excellence text section saharanpur
columns.content:
Honouring Student Achievements at DPS Saharanpur

At Delhi Public School, Saharanpur, we believe that every student carries within them the promise of excellence. Recognizing and celebrating student achievements is deeply embedded in our school culture—it inspires self-belief, sets higher benchmarks, and cultivates a spirit of healthy competition among peers. Our students continue to excel across academics, sports, arts, and leadership, bringing pride to the institution.

Academic Distinction

Academic achievement is a key focus at DPS Saharanpur. Our students consistently secure top ranks in school examinations, board results, and national-level entrance and scholarship tests. High performers are acknowledged at our annual Academic Excellence Awards and featured in school newsletters and honor boards. Participation and success in Olympiads, quizzes, science fairs, and subject-based competitions are also celebrated, encouraging academic curiosity and excellence.

Achievements in Sports

DPS Saharanpur has a growing legacy of sporting success. Our students actively participate and win accolades in a variety of sports such as football, cricket, athletics, swimming, badminton, table tennis—and notably, shooting. Several of our young sharpshooters have made us proud by winning medals at the national level, showcasing extraordinary focus, control, and dedication. Achievements at inter-house, inter-school, district, state, and national levels are honoured through medal ceremonies, sports assemblies, and a dedicated Achievement Display Wall. These recognitions not only celebrate victories but also reinforce the values of teamwork, discipline, and perseverance.

Creative and Cultural Excellence

From fine arts and music to debate, drama, and dance, our students have showcased their talents on multiple platforms with remarkable success. Their achievements in inter-school competitions, exhibitions, and cultural forums are celebrated through school functions, creative showcases, and appreciation assemblies. Every artistic contribution is valued as a unique form of self-expression and cultural enrichment.

Inter School Literary Fest – A Celebration of Intellect and Expression

One of the proudest highlights for DPS Saharanpur was securing the First Position in the Inter School Literary Fest, where our students competed in events such as debate, creative writing, elocution, and quiz competitions. This achievement reflects the intellectual strength and articulate expression we nurture in our learners, and it stands as a shining example of our vibrant literary culture.

Leadership and Social Responsibility

Our students are encouraged to lead with vision and empathy. Through platforms like the Student Council, Model United Nations, and various social outreach initiatives, students take on meaningful roles both within and beyond the school. Those who demonstrate responsibility, initiative, and a commitment to service are recognised and celebrated, inspiring a spirit of civic-minded leadership.

Celebrating Every Success

At DPS Saharanpur, every milestone—big or small—is honoured with equal pride. From classroom accomplishments to achievements on national platforms, we ensure each student feels seen, valued, and motivated to strive further. By celebrating success in its many forms, we nurture a culture of aspiration, where every learner is empowered to reach their full potential.

Celebrating Performing Arts at DPS Saharanpur

At Delhi Public School, Saharanpur, we believe that the performing arts are not just a means of expression—they are essential to a child’s holistic growth. Through dance, music, and theatre, students are encouraged to explore their creativity, build self-assurance, and form a deeper connection with culture, heritage, and themselves. We take pride in nurturing artistic talent and bringing it to the forefront.

Dance – Grace in Motion

At DPS Saharanpur, dance is embraced as both an art form and a discipline. Students are introduced to a variety of styles—from classical Indian dance to modern and folk forms—under the guidance of skilled instructors. Regular performances during school events, national celebrations, and inter-house competitions give students opportunities to showcase their skills, rhythm, and expression on stage.

Music – The Voice Within

Music plays a vibrant role in campus life. Whether it's Indian classical, Western vocals, or instrumental training, students receive structured instruction to explore their musical abilities. Our school choir, solo performers, and instrumentalists frequently perform during assemblies, cultural programs, and inter-school events. Music is not only a creative outlet but also a tool that enhances concentration, emotional well-being, and discipline.

Theatre and Stagecraft

Theatre at DPS Saharanpur empowers students to express themselves boldly and think critically. From acting and scriptwriting to stage design and production, our theatre program introduces students to every aspect of the dramatic arts. Annual functions, literary fests, and inter-school competitions serve as platforms where budding performers bring stories to life, while developing confidence, communication, and collaboration  skills.

At DPS Saharanpur, the performing arts are more than co-curricular—they are a celebration of identity, imagination, and innovation. Every performance is a step toward confidence, creativity, and character.

Together, we strive to shape a future where every child excels not just in academics, but in all aspects of life.

columns.title: DPS Saharanpur Image Section
columns.content:
In the year 2008, residents of Saharanpur witnessed a new surge in the Education world. The much awaited and awed Delhi Public School laid its foundations in the city with record-breaking admissions of over 500 students in the very first year. There has been no looking back ever since!

The great visionary and founder of the school, Pro-Vice Chairman Mr Mukhtarul Amin with the school moto of ‘Service Before Self’ promised an all-round development of each student under the Superhouse Group umbrella.

Under the stewardship of School Principal Mrs Poonam Srivastava, School got its affiliation from CBSE for class X in the year 2011 and for class XII in 2014 for all the three streams- Science, Commerce and Humanities. It was the first School in Saharanpur to make all the options available to the students.

It has indeed been a very successful journey for Delhi Public School, Saharanpur. In terms of achievements, accolades and accomplishments, be it scholastic or co-scholastic areas, school has been leading to a complete all round holistic development of the students. The Eventful and fulfilling journey continues…

columns.title: DPS Society Content Section
columns.content:
The Delhi Public School Society (DPSS) is a non-profit, non-proprietary educational body widely recognized for its selfless and unstinting committed to excellence in education.

The DPSS established its first school in 1949 at Mathura Road in New Delhi. Today it has more than 200 schools in India and abroad apart from 13 core schools and its affiliates in Delhi and NCR alone.

Under the able guidance of stalwarts like Shri B K Chaturvedi , Chairman DPSS and, Shri V K Shunglu, Vice Chairman, DPSS seeks to provide holistic and quality education to all members of society. This is suitably reflected in its motto ' Service before Self '. DPS Schools have produced self-confident, self-reliant individuals who are versatile and endowed with a spirit of adventure and creativity.

The Council of Educational Planning and Training (CEPT) encourages and promotes innovative trends in education that help both the teachers and the students. The Council of Environment Education and Culture (CEEC) helps children in all DPS schools to value, conserve and preserve their natural environment. The Arts and Heritage Council, the Media, Publication, Sports and Health divisions also foster quality education.

sections.title: DPS Society Section 2
sections.content:
The DPSS has initiated the setting up of Shiksha Kendra that enable children from the underprivileged sections of society to be educated and empowered. Projects like the EDULINKS (Satellite based collaborative learning) and LEAP (Learning Exchange and Association Platform) have linked together various DPS Schools.

Thus DPS Society has proved that with determination, good management, right vision and altruism one can produce global citizens with the right moral fiber, who are ready to be the torchbearers of the 21st century.

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: Chairman's Message

columns.title: Chairman's Message Content Section
columns.content:
In this age of relentless competition and rapid change, it is important for the youth to live a morally upright and value-driven life. At our institution, we are committed to nurturing these values in our students. We strive to provide not just academic excellence, but also a strong moral foundation that will guide them throughout their lives.
Our team of dedicated and passionate educators is constantly investing their time, energy, and expertise to realize the vision and objectives of the school. Their unwavering commitment ensures that every child is encouraged to grow intellectually, emotionally, and ethically.
I extend my heartfelt gratitude to all our parents, staff, and well-wishers for their continued trust and support. Together, we are building a future rooted in integrity, knowledge, and compassion.

We hope to pass on not only great scholars but also sensitive, compassionate and responsible young adults to the society.

As a premier educational institution, we are known for creating our own benchmarks and elevating ourselves to higher planes. This practice has made our group schools excellent centres of learning.

"However, learning, evolving and effort will never cease."

sections.content_heading: Principal's Message

columns.title: Principal's Message Content Section
columns.content:
The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.

We are proud to provide a world class education, celebrating the fact that each student is different as a person and as a learner. As a 21st century organization, the school desires to set an approach to learning that incorporates enquiry, research, analytical thinking and ethical approach that becomes a lifetime habit of a student. Our distinction lies in the pursuit of high academic attainment through committed teachers, motivated students and professional administration.

We live in a world that is very different from the one, we were educated in. The dynamic nature of education has made us – the educators to pause and reflect on this entire system of education. We have adopted strategies to improve school system and embrace the innovative means to educate our learners.

Combining face to face lectures with digital technologies give rise to blended learning which increase the learning potential of the students.

At DPS, Saharanpur we nurture young saplings with love and care, inculcating optimistic attitude and perseverance, backed by strong dedication because what they are is God’s gift to us and what they become is our gift to God.

sections.title: School Guidelines Section2
sections.content:
RESPECT, RESPONSIBILITY AND EXCELLENCE


1. SAFETY AND SECURITY

  • ❖ It is mandatory for students to carry their Identity cards.
  • ❖ Parents/ Guardians should update the class teacher on any changes in address, contact information or guardianship to ensure accurate records.
  • ❖ Students escorted to and from school must wait for the escort to arrive and report delays to the school office.
  • ❖ Students are not allowed to visit relatives or friend’s houses from school without written permission from parents/ guardians.
  • ❖ Students are expected to be environmentally friendly and contribute to protecting the environment.
  • ❖For safety, students should not buy or accept articles, gifts or food from anyone en route.


2.ATTENDANCE AND PUNCTUALITY

  • ❖Organizers must be brought to school everyday.
  • ❖ School is functional from Monday to Saturday for classes VI-XII and Monday to Friday for PG-V. The school gates will close 5 minutes after the bell rings.


3.DISCIPLINARY ÉTIQUETTES

  • ❖ No loitering after bell rings; movement must be quiet and orderly, keeping to the left in corridors and staircases.
  • ❖ Students should follow staff instructions and wait for their transportation in designated areas.
  • ❖ Respect and care for school property. Damages caused intentionally will result in fine and appropriate disciplinary actions.
  • ❖ Students are responsible for their belongings. Name tags are recommended for all personal items, especially jackets and sweaters.
  • ❖ Expensive gifts, eatables and cake cutting for birthdays are strictly prohibited.
  • ❖ Jewellery, mobile phones, cameras and other electronics are not allowed. Confiscated items may be held until parents retrieve them with a signed undertaking.
  • ❖ Use dustbins for waste disposal and contribute to keeping the premises clean and litter free.


4. BEHAVIOURAL EXPECTATIONS

  • ❖ Respect and Responsibility: Students should treat teachers, staff and peers with respect and uphold a positive school image
  • ❖ Anti-Bullying Policy: The school maintains a zero tolerance stance on bullying in any form. Violations will result in serious disciplinary measures, including possible suspension or expulsion.
  • ❖ Orderly Movement: Observe silence and exhibit appropriate behavior in hallways, during assembly and at dispersal.


5. LEAVE RULES

  • ❖ 75% of the attendance in the academic session is compulsory for students to be eligible for the final assessment.
  • ❖ Attendance on the reopening day after the vacations is mandatory.
  • ❖ Emergency Leave: In case of emergency leave application should be duly signed and mailed to the school positively.
  • ❖ Planned Leave: Submit requests for planned absences at least one week in advance.
  • ❖ No student will be permitted to leave the school premises during PAs unless under the above conditions.


6. HEALTH GUIDELINES AND SICK LEAVE

  • ❖ Reporting Illness: Inform the school in case of illness within 24 hours. A medical certificate is required for absences longer than three days along with the duly signed application.
  • ❖ Infectious Diseases: If your child catches infectious disease, inform the school immediately. The child must observe the recommended quarantine period and can return only after full recovery with a medical certificate.

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: Foundational Stage

sections.title: Foundational Stage Section
sections.content:
Early Learning Philosophy at DPS Saharanpur

The foundation of a lifelong love for learning is built during the early years of education. At Delhi Public School, Saharanpur, our curriculum is carefully crafted to spark curiosity and help young learners discover their interests and strengths. We place a strong focus on essential 21st-century skills such as effective communication, teamwork, creativity, digital fluency, and an understanding of the wider world. Our passionate educators are committed to nurturing these abilities in every child.

Guiding Principles and Educational Practices:

1. Learning by Doing: Our youngest learners engage in meaningful projects and hands-on activities designed to relate to their everyday experiences and interests.

2. Child-Centric Teaching: Recognizing that every child learns differently, our teachers adapt their approaches to cater to individual learning styles and needs, celebrating each student’s unique personality.

3. Teamwork and Social Skills: Early emphasis on group activities encourages cooperation and the development of strong interpersonal skills, laying the groundwork for effective collaboration.

4. Cultivating Responsible Citizens: We embed social awareness and responsibility from the start, preparing students to be compassionate, globally conscious individuals.

5. Lifelong Learning Mindset: Our approach equips students with curiosity and adaptability, empowering them to embrace continuous learning throughout life.

6. Freedom to Explore: Children are encouraged to follow their passions and interests freely, fostering a love for self-directed learning.

7. Holistic Growth: Our teaching focuses on the comprehensive development of the child—intellectually, emotionally, socially, and physically.

8. Understanding Over Memorization: We prioritize deep understanding and application of knowledge over rote learning, helping students build critical thinking skills.

9. Encouraging Curiosity: Questioning, exploring, and investigating are actively promoted to deepen students’ comprehension and creativity.

10. Reflective Teaching: Our educators regularly evaluate and refine their teaching strategies to ensure the best possible learning outcomes for every student.

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: Secondary Stage

sections.title: Secondary Stage Section
sections.content:
Preparing Senior Students for Greater Responsibilities at DPS Saharanpur

As students progress to classes IX and beyond, they face increasing academic challenges and personal responsibilities. At Delhi Public School, Saharanpur, we focus on empowering these young learners through dynamic and innovative teaching methods, encouraging them to become proactive, independent thinkers.

1. Learning by Experience: Complex topics can be daunting, so we provide practical, hands-on activities that help students connect theory with real-world applications, making learning more meaningful.

2. Blended Learning Approach: By blending traditional classroom instruction with digital tools and  resources,

we create a flexible and engaging learning environment suited to modern-day needs.

3. Team-Based Learning: Collaborative projects and peer discussions are integral to our approach, enabling students to develop strong communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.

4. Skill Development & Innovation: We nurture entrepreneurial thinking and confidence, preparing students to be innovators who can meet future challenges with creativity and skill.

5. Personalized Teaching: Understanding that each student has unique learning needs, our educators  customize

their teaching strategies to support diverse abilities and learning styles.

6. Inclusive and Respectful Learning: Our teaching embraces the cultural richness of our student community, fostering an atmosphere of inclusivity and mutual respect.

7. Step-by-Step Support: Challenging concepts are broken down with guided support, gradually encouraging students to take ownership of their learning and master difficult material with confidence.

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: Sr Secondary Stage

sections.title: Sr Secondary Stage Section
sections.content:
Empowering Senior Students at DPS Saharanpur

With senior classes come greater challenges and responsibilities. At Delhi Public School, Saharanpur, we are committed to equipping every student from Class IX onwards with innovative and student-centered learning experiences. Our goal is to nurture active, self-driven learners prepared for future success.

1.Experiential Learning: Complex topics can be better understood through practical, hands-on activities that make learning engaging and relevant.

2.Blended Learning: We integrate traditional teaching methods with digital tools to create a flexible and dynamic learning environment that meets the needs of today’s students.

3.Collaborative Learning: Through group projects and peer discussions, students develop crucial communication and teamwork skills essential for both academics and life.

4.Building Future-Ready Skills & Entrepreneurship: We encourage creativity, critical thinking, and confidence so students are empowered to innovate and adapt to the evolving demands of the world.

5.Personalized Instruction: Recognizing diverse learning styles, our teachers adapt their methods to ensure each student’s unique needs are met.

6.Culturally Inclusive Teaching: We celebrate the rich cultural diversity of our student body, fostering respect, inclusion, and a global perspective in the classroom.

7.Guided Learning Support: Challenging concepts are introduced with gradual support, helping students build understanding step-by-step and gain independence in their learning journey.

sections.content_heading: Rules and Regulations

sections.title: Rules and Regulations Section
sections.content:
Students should be clean and neatly dressed. The school uniform is to be worn every day and for all the functions and activities. No slogan writing or scribbling is permitted either on the school uniform or on the person. The offence will be dealt with severely.

Students are expected to respect school property. No student should damage any school furniture, write or draw anything on the walls or in any way damage things belonging to others. Damage done even by an accident should be reported at once to the class teacher or in the office. Any damage done will be made good by the one who causes it. Anyone who notices something damaged should report the matter to the school authorities even if he or she does not know who is responsible.

No shouting or whistling is allowed in the school campus.

Throwing things at others is strictly forbidden.

Students are not allowed to bring any sharp instruments such as knives, scissors etc. to the school, or any kind of object that can cause injury to others.

Students who commute in the care of servants should never leave before the servant arrives. In case of delay, they should inform the school office.

The school reserves the right to suspend or to take strict disciplinary action against a student whose diligence or progress in studies is constantly unsatisfactory, or whose conduct is harmful to other students.

Parents are required to inform the school if there is any change in their address and/or telephone numbers.

No student is allowed to visit any of the kiosks situated around the school, and if caught doing so, will be subjected to regular punishment.

Students indulging in aggressive or violent behaviour will be picked up from and dropped to the school by their parents. They will not be allowed to travel by school bus.

sections.content_heading: Discipline Rules

sections.title: Discipline Rules Section
sections.content:
School is functional for the students from Monday to Saturday.

Students must carry their Organizer/Almanac to school every day. Parents should check it regularly.

All students are expected to reach school before the morning bell rings. The school gates will be closed 5 minutes after the bell rings.

A disciplinary action will be taken if the children are repeatedly late to school.

Students who come to school with their escorts will not be permitted to leave the school with anyone else. In case of an emergency, the person must carry an authority letter from the parent to pick up the child.

Students are not allowed to go to a relative or friend’s house from school.

Students using the school bus should maintain discipline in the bus. Bus facility will be withdrawn in the cases where discipline is not properly maintained.

Students are to be tidy and neatly dressed in school uniform on all working days and school functions.

All the text books and exercise books should be neatly covered and properly labelled. All the belongings of students must bear their name, class and section.

No books (other than text books or library books) should be brought to the school.

The school is not responsible for goods that are lost. It is advisable not to bring valuable articles like expensive watches, fancy stationery items and items of jewellery etc.

Mobile phones or any other electronic gadget, if found with the student, will be confiscated and action will be taken.

Lending or borrowing of money or any other articles is strictly prohibited.

Care must be taken of all school property. Students should be trained not to damage any school furniture, write or draw anything on the walls. Recovery of any damage will be done from the concerned student.

Students are advised to keep their classrooms, school building, and campus neat and clean. Waste leftover material must be thrown into the dustbins only.

Students should observe polite behaviour. Shouting, bullying or use of foul language is forbidden.

sections.content_heading: Transport Rules

sections.title: Transport Rules Section
sections.content:
AVAILABILITY OF TRANSPORT FACILITY

  • The transport will be available depending on the number of students from any particular area. In case the school transport is not available, the parents will have to make their own arrangements.
  • The transport fee is payable in advance.
  • Partial or one way usage of school transport is not allowed. One month’s notice to the transport incharge is required for withdrawal of transport facility.
  • Violation of any rule or code of conduct mentioned below may result in fine/debarment of the transport facility to the student.

ROUTES / BUS STOP / BUS TIMING

  • The route is prepared keeping in view the convenience and safety of all bus commuters and is subject to change. No diversion/extension will be entertained on existing routes.
  • The drivers are authorised to stop buses at designated stops only unless otherwise directed by the Bus Incharge.
  • Regarding any change of bus stop, the Guardian must intimate the Transport in charge , one month in advance.
  • The students should reach the respective bus stop ten minutes earlier than the stipulated time.
  • Buses will not wait for the latecomers.
  • Parents when they visit the school for any purpose will not be allowed to take their ward along with them, without prior intimation to the Class Teacher/Transport Incharge

GENERAL CONDUCT AND BEHAVIOUR

  • Discarding of trash or food either inside or outside the bus is not permitted.
  • Unruly behaviour like hitting or shouting is strictly prohibited.
  • Students will be held responsible for any damage to buses caused by their negligence and will be charged fine accordingly.
  • Courteous behaviour is expected at all times.
  • The bus martials will ensure discipline in the bus.

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: Parents Expected To

sections.title: Parents Expected To Section
sections.content:
Monitor their ward’s progress by checking the school almanac every day and paying attention to their punctuality, discipline and submission of school assignments.

To encourage their ward to take a balanced interest in studies, co-curricular activities and sports.

To inform the school immediately, if there is any change in address, telephone numbers and bus route.

To restrict pocket money to minimal. Excessive spending in school should be discouraged.

To ensure that during their ward’s absence from school, work done in the class is made up for.

To provide a supportive value-based environment to their ward at home by discretion and parental judgement, keep track of their ward’s mental health and emotions.

To monitor the internet access of their ward and limit television viewing to appropriate programmes and duration.

Contact school to discuss and decide a plan of action to handle the difficulties (academic as well and behavioural) of their ward and to seek guidance. Your letters will be replied to after discussion with the concerned teachers.

To ensure that their ward appears for all tests as per the schedule given in the Almanac. In case the child is unable to take the examination, prior intimation must be given to the Class Teacher in writing.

To discourage their ward from taking additional leaves during examinations days.

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: Leave

sections.title: Leave Section
sections.content:
1. Leave Approval: Student’s leave must be approved by the appropriate authority.

2. Leave Application: Parents should fill up the Leave Application provided in the school Almanac for each day of absence, stating the reason. A student who was absent the previous day will not be admitted without submitting the application.

3. Long Absences: Repeated absence without leave or continuous absence for more than 10 days may result in the student’s name being struck off the rolls. Re-admission is allowed only upon payment of the admission fee and if a vacancy exists.

4. Attendance Requirement: All students are expected to attend school on the first day after every vacation. 75% yearly attendance is mandatory for appearing in final assessments and for academic awards.

5. Post-Illness Protocol: Students returning after an infectious/contagious disease must bring a doctor’s fitness certificate.

6. Quarantine Periods: Students must observe the following quarantine durations:

  • Chicken Pox: Till all scabs have fallen off
  • Cholera: Till medically fit
  • Measles: After rashes disappear
  • Mumps: Until swelling subsides (about one month)
  • Whooping Cough: 6 weeks
  • Jaundice: 6 weeks

sections.content_heading: Withdrawal Rules

sections.title: Withdrawal Rules Section
sections.content:
One clear calendar months’ notice in writing, or a month's fees in lieu of such notice must be given before a pupil can be withdrawn.
Those who leave the school in April must in all cases pay the fees for the month of June.
Transfer Certificates are not issued until all dues of the school are settled.

Students can be asked to leave the school on the following grounds:
a) Indiscipline
b) Any two detentions

A student who fails twice will not be permitted to continue his/her studies in the school, especially if he/she is below average in that class.
If the name has been struck off the rolls twice, the student will not be readmitted to school.

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: Admission Procedure

sections.title: Admission Procedure Section
sections.content:
"Give me a spark of Nature's fire That's all the learning I desire."

ROBERT BURNS

Learning is an eternal process; whether self-study, experience or being taught, it strengthens character and mental powers. Education systematically develops such powers and brings out children's potential existence. It adorns them with self-confidence and self-realisation of their inborn qualities.

Education is one of the birth rights of every child, and providing it is every parent's supreme duty. Good and quality education must be provided to all children. It is a good indication for the nation that parents have recognized the value of education and are committed to putting their beloved ones in the best schools around them. It is their cherished dream today.

A school is a place not only to acquire academic excellence but also to develop all faculties of mind, intellectually and spiritually, which results in the holistic development of a child.

Schooling starts at an early age of 3+ years. Admission to Nursery class is the initial step toward a long journey. Well begun is half done. DPS Saharanpur provides an excellent launching pad to every child through an outstanding education system in Pre-Primary classes.

ADMISSION PROCESS FOR PRE-PRIMARY

  • Registration is the first step. Prospectus given at the time of registration gives complete information about the school system.
  • Admission to Pre Nursery will be through informal interaction with the parents and the child.
  • Date and timing for interaction will be intimated.
  • Nursery & Prep : There will be a written test conducted and an interaction of the parents with the Principal.
  • List of selected candidates will be displayed by the Administrative Office.
  • On confirmation of admission, parents will be required to deposit fee within the stipulated time, failing which the admission shall stand cancelled.

IMPORTANT DOCUMENTS TO BE ATTACHED AT THE TIME OF REGISTRATION

  • Marksheet of the previous Examination held (for Class I and above)
  • Self attested photocopy of Birth Certificate of child issued by Muncipal Corporation/Competent Authority.
  • Previous School’s ID Card.
  • A Copy of self- attested Aadhar Card. (Not Mandatory)
  • Two passport size photographs.

ADMISSION PROCESS FOR CLASSES I - VIII

  • Registration is the first step. Prospectus given at the time of registration gives complete information about the school system.
  • Admission to classes I and above is given based on the result of an admission test conducted by the school.
  • Date, Time and Syllabus for admission test may be collected from School Administrative Office at the time of registration.
  • Result of Admission Test will be displayed at the School Administrative Office.
  • Registration/Admission in a particular class depends on seats available.

DOCUMENTS REQUIRED AT THE TIME OF ADMISSION

  • Self- attested copy of Aadhar Card. (Not Mandatory)
  • Filled up form and two passport size photographs.
  • Self -attested copy of Birth Certificate.
  • Original Birth Certificate for verification.
  • Self -attested copy of Previous School’s Report Card.
  • Original Transfer Certificate.
  • Original Character Certificate.
  • Caste Certificate for ST/SC/OBC/EWS.
  • Certificate for disability if any.
  • Medical Fitness Certificate from Chief Medical Officer/Registered Medical Practitioner.
  • Self attested Xerox copy of the Child's Immunization Card (Classes Pre Primary - I)

ADMISSION PROCESS FOR CLASS XI

  • Registration for admission to Class XI Science and Commerce stream begins by the end of March.
  • Admission in Class XI is given on the basis of Written Admission Test and Personal Interview of the candidate with the Principal.
  • Admission Test of Class XI is conducted either on the first or second week of April.

DOCUMENTS REQUIRED AT THE TIME OF ADMISSION

  • Self -attested copy of Aadhar Card Parents & Child. (Not Mandatory)
  • Filled up form and two passport size photographs.
  • Self attested copy of Class X Mark sheet and Pass Certificate.
  • Original Transfer Certificate.
  • Original Character Certificate.
  • Caste Certificate for ST/SC/OBC/EWS.
  • Certificate for disability if any.
  • Medical Fitness Certificate from Chief Medical Officer/Registered Medical Practitioner.

columns.title: Health And Physical Fitness Image Section
Health And Physical Fitness Content Section
columns.content:
Our Health and Fitness Assessment is designed to provide a complete evaluation of overall physical and mental well-being. Unlike routine fitness checks, this assessment covers all the major components of fitness to help individuals understand their strengths and areas of improvement.

We assess:

  • Endurance & Stamina – measuring the ability to sustain physical activity over time.
  • Speed & Power – evaluating quickness, explosive movements, and reaction time.
  • Strength & Agility – testing muscle power, mobility, and efficiency of movement.
  • Flexibility & Coordination – ensuring joint health, posture, and smooth motor control.
  • Cardiovascular & Cardiorespiratory Fitness – assessing heart and lung efficiency for optimal performance.
  • Aerobic & Anaerobic Capacity – measuring energy systems used during different intensity levels.
  • Body Balance & Mental Abilities – checking stability, focus, and cognitive functions linked to performance.

This holistic approach ensures that every dimension of fitness—physical, mental, and physiological—is taken into account, offering valuable insights for athletes, students, and individuals striving for better health.

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: Domestic Exchange Program

columns.title: Domestic Exchange Program Content Section
columns.content: At DPS Saharanpur, we actively facilitate domestic exchange programs with our sister branches across various cities. These visits foster collaborative learning among students. These programs aim to broaden students' perspectives, enhance interpersonal skills and promote unity in diversity. Participating students experience different regional cultures, school environments and academic practices. Activities include joint projects, interactive sessions and local excursions, enriching both academic and social experiences. The exchange fosters a strong sense of belonging within the DPS community and encourages adaptability and mutual respect.

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: International Exchange Program

columns.title: International Exchange Program Content Section
columns.content:
Delhi Public School (DPS) provides valuable international exchange initiatives, available in both online and offline formats. Their goal is to promote global awareness and cross-cultural understanding among students. These initiatives allow students to interact with classmates from institutions in nations such as Singapore, the USA, the UK, France, Germany, Japan, and Australia.

Offline exchange programs usually include student trips to educational institutions overseas. The attendees encounter firsthand various new educational systems, cultures, and traditions. These engaging experiences feature educational sessions, cultural excursions, and cooperative initiatives that foster global friendship and knowledge.

Understanding worldwide travel restrictions, DPS has also created strong online exchange programs. Via online classrooms, joint projects, webinars, and cultural exhibitions, students keep establishing global connections and expanding their viewpoints while staying at home. Not long ago, we held a virtual cultural exchange with Morrow High School in Georgia (USA). The students gathered to observe and talk about educational methods, culture, art, and more.

columns.title: Animation Content Section
columns.content:
Superhouse Foundation in its endeavour to provide holistic Education proudly announces the launch of Animation Master Class. The Animation School, besides developing the right values and attitude in the students, will also develop their sensorial skills and aesthetic sensitivity necessary for the creative field.


The school boasts of an in-house dedicated team for content development which has created an age-appropriate curriculum keeping in mind the profile of students. Besides this, we have a team of experts for training the faculty in the curriculum implementation & latest development in the field of Animation.

sections.title: Animation Section2
sections.content:
About Animation

Animation is a new dimension of Art, which uses technology to develop ideas for creation of moving visuals. Today, Digital Animation & VFX are used in various industries like Advertising, Web Designing, Television, Films, Medicine, Education, e-Learning, Architecture, Legal & Insurance, and Gaming (PC, Internet, Mobile & Consoles).

The program at Animation Masterclass is packed with interesting assignments, live projects & competitions which makes learning fun & exciting. Students will work on the latest software & state-of-the-art machines.

Why Animation for Children

This course provides an exciting opportunity for students to develop their aesthetic, imaginative & expressive abilities through a combination of Art and Animation. Animation training provides the necessary direction, facilities and experience to develop creativity and thereby help each individual to discover his/her own identity and potential.

A child develops an understanding of the multi-disciplinary nature of design and its relationship with the environment, culture, human senses and emotions.

Special Highlights

  • Concept Development & Visualizations
  • Graphics Design & Image Editing
  • 3D Architecture & Design
  • Visual Effects
  • Visual & Sound Editing

Our Programs

Primary Level Programs (Class – 3rd & 4th)

  • An introduction to the world of graphics where kids learn with fun and develop their creative skill.
  • Teaching children how they can create more effective thoughts in digital space.
  • Exploring their talents and getting familiar with advanced yet creative technology at a young age.
  • Understanding the basic concepts of digital drawing, editing and photo manipulations.

Middle Level Programs (Class – 5th & 6th)

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: Counselling-cell

sections.title: Counselling-cell Section
sections.content:
At Delhi Public School, Saharanpur, health and well-being form an integral part of our school ethos. We believe that true education goes beyond academics — it must nurture the body, mind, and emotions to shape confident, balanced individuals. Our focus is on creating a safe, healthy, and encouraging environment where every child can flourish.

To promote an active lifestyle and physical fitness, we offer:

  • Daily physical education classes and structured sports training
  • A wide range of activities including yoga, aerobics, athletics, martial arts, and team games
  • Regular health check-ups and awareness camps for students
  • Emphasis on balanced nutrition and healthy eating habits within the campus
  • Clean, well-maintained infrastructure with access to safe drinking water

We also place strong emphasis on emotional well-being and mental resilience. Our initiatives include:

  • Counselling services to support social, emotional, and academic growth
  • Mindfulness practices and relaxation sessions integrated into school life
  • Workshops on life skills, self-esteem, and building positive peer relationships
  • A warm and approachable mentor system that ensures students always feel supported

At DPS Saharanpur, hygiene and safety are non-negotiable. We  ensure:

  • Regular sanitisation of classrooms, labs, and common areas
  • Health and hygiene awareness drives for students
  • Presence of trained staff for first aid and emergency medical assistance
  • A secure, closely monitored campus that prioritises student safety and well-being

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: Peer Education Program

columns.title: Peer Education Program Content Section
columns.content:
We aim to cultivate stronger bonds among students and an ability to uplift one another. Thus, the Peer Educator Programme trains selected students to become leaders, role models and resource persons for their classmates. These student leaders help promote positive behaviour and social responsibility.

Objectives:

● Promote awareness of health, hygiene, life skills, and social values.
● Develop leadership skills and self-confidence in students.
● Support peers in academic, emotional and social aspects.
● Foster teamwork, empathy and community engagement.

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: Shiksha Kendra

columns.title: Shiksha Kendra Content Section
columns.content:
Shiksha Kendra is our school’s program aimed at offering quality education to underprivileged children in our community. This parallel institution on our campus reflects our dedication to inclusive development, compassion, and social accountability.

Founded with the goal of "Education for All," Shiksha Kendra invites students from financially underprivileged backgrounds. We provide them with free academic teaching, healthy meals, uniforms, and educational resources. Our committed group of educators and volunteers establish a supportive atmosphere. Here we encourage learning, self-assurance, and essential life skills. The senior students are urged to engage in voluntary teaching and mentorship initiatives. In this way, we foster a culture of kindness and support from an early age. By offering chances for underprivileged children, we strive to close the educational divide and foster a more inclusive community.

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: S.E.W.A

columns.title: S.E.W.A Content Section
columns.content:
At our school, SEWA (Social Empowerment through Work Education and Action) represents more than just a program—it's a lifestyle. Based on the fundamental principles of empathy, responsibility, and collaboration, SEWA offers students practical experiences that link their classroom education with actual social issues.

Each SEWA activity is intended to promote leadership, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities while nurturing a feeling of pride in serving the community. It corresponds with the CBSE's comprehensive educational philosophy and enables students to engage actively in improving society.

Through SEWA, students participate in various activities, such as cleanliness initiatives, environmental projects, visits to senior care facilities, assistance for children with disabilities, and awareness campaigns addressing topics like health, hygiene, and gender equality. These activities assist students in becoming socially aware and empathetic individuals, prepared to create a positive influence.

columns.title: Career Guidance and Counselling Program Content Section
columns.content:
Guidance and Counselling

Empowering Students for a Brighter Future

At Delhi Public School, Kalyanpur, we believe in nurturing the potential of every student. Our goal is to provide comprehensive career guidance and counseling that helps students discover their passion, align their interests with suitable career paths, and make informed decisions about their future.

Our Mission
We aim to equip students with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to navigate the complex world of careers. By offering opportunities for counseling resources, we empower students to take charge of their educational and professional journeys.

sections.title: What We Offer Section
sections.content:
What We Offer

1. Career Exploration
We help students explore different career options based on their strengths, interests, and values.

2. Educational Pathways
Choosing the right courses and subjects is essential to achieving career goals. Our educators and counselors work closely with students to:
  • Select subjects that align with their career aspirations.
  • Understand the academic requirements for different career paths.
  • Provide guidance on advanced studies, scholarships, and college applications.

3. Skills Development
In today's competitive world, academic knowledge is not enough. We offer workshops and training in:
  • Communication Skills: Helping students express themselves confidently.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Developing critical thinking abilities.
  • Time Management: Teaching students how to balance academic work with extracurricular activities.

4. Career Talks and Seminars
We organize interactive sessions with industry professionals and experts to:
  • Introduce students to real-world career experiences.
  • Provide insights into emerging fields and industries.
  • Offer practical tips on how to succeed in various careers.

5. College and Career Planning
Whether students are planning to attend college or enter the workforce after school, we offer tailored guidance on:
  • College selection and applications.
  • Letter of Recommendation (LoR).

Contact Us
For LoR, write to: guidanceandcounselling@dpskalyanpur.com with complete details about the University/ies you wish to apply for and your testimonials.

columns.title: Library Content Section
columns.content:
Cultivating a Lifelong Love for Reading

At Delhi Public School, Saharanpur, we believe that reading forms the foundation of lifelong learning. To nurture a love for books and strengthen literacy skills, we have introduced a comprehensive Reading Programme that inspires students to become confident, curious, and independent readers.

Our Reading Programme

The programme is carefully designed across all grades with age-appropriate reading activities such as:

    >
  • Guided reading sessions
  • Storytelling and book reviews
  • Author interactions

Reading challenges and literary games

These initiatives not only enhance vocabulary, comprehension, and critical thinking but also encourage creativity, empathy, and imagination through diverse literary experiences.

Our Library – A Hub of Learning

The school library is a vibrant centre of knowledge and creativity, equipped with:

    >
  • A wide collection of fiction, non-fiction, and reference books
  • Periodicals and journals for current awareness
  • Digital resources for research and exploration

With its warm and inviting environment, the library promotes both academic research and the joy of leisure reading.

Enriching the Reading Culture

Regular library periods, reading clubs, and literary events further enrich students’ reading journeys, making the library a cherished and integral part of school life.

We are committed to building a strong reading culture that empowers our students to explore, imagine, and grow — one book at a time.

sections.content_heading: Withdrawal Policy

sections.title: Withdrawal Policy Section
sections.content:
One clear calendar month's notice in writing, or a month's fees in lieu of such notice must be given before a pupil can be withdrawn.

Those who leave the school in April must in all cases pay the fees for the month of June.

Transfer Certificates are not issued until all dues of the school are settled.

Students can be asked to leave the school on the following grounds:

  • Indiscipline
  • Any two detentions

A student who fails twice will not be permitted to continue his/her studies in the school, especially if he/she is below average in that class.

If the name has been struck off the rolls twice, the student will not be readmitted to school.

sections.content_heading: Transfer Certificate Guidelines

sections.title: Transfer Certificate Guidelines Section
sections.content:
Parents/Guardians seeking a Transfer Certificate (TC) from Delhi Public School, Saharanpur are requested to kindly follow the guidelines given below:

Procedure for Applying

  • A written application for Transfer Certificate must be submitted to the school office, duly signed by the parent/guardian.
  • All school dues must be cleared before the Transfer Certificate is issued.
  • The student must return all library books, sports items, or any other school property before applying.
  • The application should clearly mention:
    • Student’s full name
    • Admission number
    • Class & section
    • Reason for transfer
    • Name of the school where admission is being sought (if applicable)

Issue of Transfer Certificate

  • The Transfer Certificate will be prepared and issued within 7 working days after the application and clearance of dues.
  • Parents/Guardians will be informed by the school office once the TC is ready for collection.
  • The TC will be issued only after being signed by the Principal.

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: Group Transfer Policy

sections.title: Group Transfer Policy Section
sections.content:
1. Transfer is not a right; it is a facility provided by the school management on a goodwill basis.

  1. Transfer will be granted only if a seat is available in the branch where the student wishes to shift.

  2. No test will be conducted if the student submits an authentic and verified report card.

  3. In transfer cases, the student will have to pay only the differential amount in the admission fee in the receiving branch.

  4. In case of multiple transfers, a fee of ₹1000/- will be charged for each transfer beyond the first one.

  5. All original documents, security, and no-dues certificate related to the student must be submitted by the current SEF branch to the receiving SEF branch, duly attested by the Principal.

  6. These rules are subject to change and may be revised by the school management from time to time.

sections.title: Our Curriculum Section
sections.content:
Delhi Public School Bareilly is affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) New Delhi, which is the largest educational board in the country.

We Follow the CBSE curriculum. The entire learning tenure of a child’s life is divided into early education, elementary education, secondary education and senior secondary education. In our 10+2 format, we have kindergarten segment consisting of Playgroup, Nursery and Preparatory. The Primary Section includes classes I to V and the secondary section covers the classes VI-X. The senior secondary comprises of classes XI & XII. Hence your child entire school life is set within the best available infrastructure, faculty and compatible environment. Choosing the right school, will be one of the most important decisions you will have to make to define your child's future. Like hundreds of parents in the past, you too can be sure of ensuring the very best for your child.

ROBERT BURNS

Learning is an eternal process, may it be self study, experience or being taught, it leads to strengthening of character and mental powers. Education provides a systematic development of such powers and it brings out the potential existence of children. It adorns them with self confidence and self realization of their inborn qualities.

Education is one of the birth rights of every child and to provide it, is every parent’s supreme duty. Good and quality education must be provided to all children and it is a good indication for the nation that parents have recognized the value of education and are committed to put their beloved ones in best of the schools around them. This is their cherished dream today.

School is a place not only to acquire academic excellence but also to develop all faculties of mind, intellectually and spiritually, which results in holistic development of a child.

Schooling starts at an early age of 3 years. Admission in PNC class is the initial step towards a long journey. Well begun is half done. DPS Bareilly provides an excellent launching pad to every child in the form of an outstanding system of education in Pre-Primary classes.

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: Our Story

sections.title: Our Story Section
sections.content:
Delhi Public School, Saharanpur, under the aegis of Delhi Public School Society, is a CBSE affiliated school run under the umbrella of Superhouse Education Foundation. The School has flourished under the leadership of Pro-Vice Chairman Mr Mukhtarul Amin. In day to day affairs, the school is administered by School Principal Ms Adesh Sisodia.

DPS is a co-educational institution where students are given the opportunity to pursue their dreams. Our students are exposed to numerous activities and competitions which give them ample room to showcase their talents. Their special qualities and talents are honed to make each one of them stand apart from the rest. DPS aims to create well-balanced, morally sound, intelligent and tech-smart DIPSITES who can boldly face all challenges of life and create a niche for themselves.

The school provides a balanced, safe and realistic environment for young children to grow and learn. The school has a huge building with airy, sunny and spacious smart classes and a spacious library with more than 10,000 books. There are large, lush green playground for sports like Cricket, Volleyball and Football with separate Basketball and Badminton courts and also a Games room for indoor games like Chess, Carrom, TT, etc. Shooting range adds another attraction. The school proudly owns a 25 metre long swimming pool with an excellent filtration plant to keep the pool clean and keeps the students away from any infections diseases.

There are three air-conditioned Computer Labs with more than 200 Computers, well-equipped Science Labs for Physics, Chemistry and Biology to help our budding scientists quench their thirst for more scientific innovations. The school also has a modern, well-designed Maths Lab, Coding Lab & Animation Lab for students of Classes I to XII.

There is also an open air Theatre where various School functions and assemblies are conducted. The Activity Rooms for weekly Thursday and Friday activities host activities like Calligraphy, Pottery, Yoga, Dance, Science club, Rifle Shooting, Urdu Classes and a special Cookery Room for those who have an inclination for Cooking. Mirrored Dance room and Music room with latest Musical Instruments give students an opportunity to learn and showcase their creativity in Dance and Music, and that’s not all… the School also conducts Personality Development Classes, Superhouse Sports Academy and Animation Classes, Coding Classes etc- the best a School can offer!!

Delhi public school has adopted technology to enhance the best teaching and learning practices. The digital app like AllenCare promotes efficient communication and on-time homework submission by improving accessibility, organization, and convenience for both students and teachers.

The use of online attendance app is one illustration of technology integration in our school. Traditionally, attendance was recorded only manually, Now, Teachers can digitally mark attendance using online apps, streamlining the process and guaranteeing accurate records.

We at DPS Saharanpur nurture young saplings with love and care, inculcating optimistic attitude and perseverance backed by strong dedication.

sections.title: Hero Banner Section
sections.content_heading: Facilities

columns.title: Facilities Content Section
columns.content:
We are living in a fast changing world. The pace of change is indeed so fast that almost everything seems to be in transformation mode. Since education cannot exist in isolation, the system needs to take cognizance of these developments.

Education all over the world is undergoing a radical shift. Knowledge is no longer constrained by time and space. It has expanded beyond the classrooms and school campuses. Hence, continuous mentoring, monitoring and evaluation of the learning environment need to be done to provide required intellectual stimulation to the young minds. In today's world, how much you know does not matter, application of the acquired knowledge is more important. This is where excellence in present day education lies.

Youth of today exhibits unparalleled genius and is to be prepared for global stage. Our pedagogical practices have to shift from teaching to learning.In emerging global dynamics, educators have to play the role of change managers.

sections.title: Facilities Section 2
sections.content:
While creating curriculum designs, value orientation should remain in prime focus. Schools should aim at grooming the students into ethical and principled leaders of tomorrow, whose thoughts and actions are deeply embedded in the values and culture of our land.

As a premier educational institution, we are known for creating our own benchmarks and elevating ourselves to higher planes. This practice has made our group schools, the centers of excellence. However learning, evolving and effort will never  cease.

POCSO and Its functioning in School:


The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act is a law designed to safeguard children from sexual abuse and exploitation. In schools, its functioning includes creating awareness among students and staff about child safety, forming an Internal Committee to address complaints, and ensuring a safe and supportive environment. Schools are also responsible for reporting any suspected abuse and conducting regular sensitization programs to educate children about their rights and protection.

sections.content_heading: FAQ's

sections.title: FAQ's Section Saharanpur
sections.content:
1. What grades does Delhi Public School, Saharanpur offer?

Ans: Delhi Public School, Saharanpur offers a whole education journey from Playgroup to grade 12th.

2. How do I enroll my child at Delhi Public School, Saharanpur?

Ans: To enroll your child, please visit the Admission page or Contact us page for detailed information and guidelines. You can also apply online through our registration form.

3. What are the school timings?

Ans: Delhi Public School, Saharanpur timings start from 8:30 A.M. to 4:30 P.M., Monday through Saturday.

4. Which board is the school affiliated with?

Ans: Our school is affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), New Delhi, under the affiliation number 2131373.

5. What is the student-teacher ratio at DPS Saharanpur?

Ans: 30:1 is the pupil-teacher ratio (PTR) mandated by the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE). The meaning of this is that for every 30 students, there should be one teacher. As per the CBSE ratio, our teacher-section ratio is 1:1.5 and student-teacher ratio is ……

6. What extracurricular activities are available?

Ans: We offer a wide range of extracurricular activities in our school, including robotics, animation, and more.

7. Does the school have boarding (residential) facilities?

Ans: No, we do not provide residential facilities. Delhi Public School, Saharanpur is a day school that gets over by 4:30 pm.

8. Does the DPS Saharanpur offer lunch or cafeteria services?

Ans: Yes, we provide our children with wholesome and delicious meals in our on-site cafeteria.

9. How often will there be PTM’s?

Ans: Based on School Content.

10. Are computer classes available at DPS Saharanpur?

Ans. Yes, computer classes are available at our school. We offer a comprehensive computer education program that includes coding like Coding Dojo. Also, these are supported by textbooks like……

11. Does Delhi Public School, Saharanpur provide medical facilities on campus?

Ans: Yes, DPS Saharanpur offers on-campus medical facilities. The school has a well-equipped medical room staffed by qualified professionals to provide first aid and attend to basic health needs of students during school hours.

12. Why Delhi Public School is so famous?

Ans: Delhi Public School (DPS) is renowned across India for its academic excellence, disciplined environment, and holistic approach to education. At DPS Saharanpur this legacy continues with a strong emphasis on quality teaching, co-curricular enrichment, modern learning technologies, and value-based education. The school's commitment to nurturing well-rounded, future-ready individuals makes it a trusted and respected name among parents and students alike.

13. Why choose Delhi Public School, Saharanpur for my child’s education?

Ans: DPS Saharanpur stands out by offering a balanced education that nurtures both academic excellence and holistic development. What truly sets us apart is our strong focus on beyond-the-curriculum learning, where students gain future-ready skills through programs in coding, animation, oluxi smart skills, and more.

14. How does Delhi Public School, Saharanpur ensure student safety and security?

Ans: Student safety is our top priority. Delhi Public School, Saharanpur has 24/7 security and CCTV facilities available.

15. Who is the founder of Delhi Public School Society?

Ans: Delhi Public School Society (DPSS), under the visionary leadership of Shri B.K. Chaturvedi (Chairman) and Shri V.K. Shunglu (Vice Chairman), is committed to delivering holistic and quality education to all members of society. This mission is deeply rooted in its guiding motto: "Service Before Self."

16. Who is the principal of DPS Saharanpur?

Ans: The principal of Delhi Public School, Saharanpur is Ms Adesh Sisodia. With extensive experience in educational leadership, she leads the school’s academic and administrative initiatives.

sections.title: Admission Section Saharanpur
sections.content:
17. What is the fee structure of the school?

Ans: The fee structure at DPS Saharanpur is thoughtfully designed to reflect the comprehensive educational experience we offer.

18. Is there an admission fee or application fee?

Ans: Yes, there is a Rs.30000/- for PG to 10th and Rs.20000/- for class 11 and 12th non-refundable application fee required at the time of submission. Visit our Admissions page for more details.

19. What is the age criteria for admission?

Ans: Please visit our Admission Process page for details.

20. Can I transfer my child mid-year?

Ans: It depends on a case-by-case basis, based on seat availability and academic compatibility.

21. What documents are required for admission?

Ans: These are the following documents, i.e., required to take admission in DPS Saharanpur..

  • ● Birth Certificate (From Nagar Nigam)
  • ● Recent passport size photographs of child, (4 photos)
  • ● Copy of Aadhar card (both parent and child)
  • ● Evidence of passing the last class (Report Card).
  • ● Transfer Certificate or School Leaving Certificate and final report card of previous school.
  • ● Any medical documents (if required).

22. Is there an entrance exam for admission?

Ans:Yes, the school conducts an entrance exam for admission to Class III to Class XI. It may be written or oral as laid down by the School for different levels. The test will be held for English, Hindi, Mathematics and/or any other subject which may be considered necessary.

The selection of the candidates will depend upon the child’s performance in the written test/ interview and availability of seats in the concerned class. Special consideration is made for Dipsites. The date of the result of the interview & the last date for the submission of fee will be specified at the time of the written test/interview.
sections.content_heading: ADMISSION

sections.title: Transportation Section Saharanpur
sections.content:
23. Does DPS Saharanpur offer transportation services?

Ans: Yes, the school provides transportation services for students across Saharanpur. To know the exact pick-up points, click here.

24. Which areas are covered by the school bus service?

Ans: Our buses cover all the nearby areas. You can check our Bus Route page for more details.

25. What are the school bus timings?

Ans: School bus timings may vary based on location. Once your child is enrolled, you will receive a detailed transportation schedule with specific pick-up and drop-off timings tailored to your route.

26. Are the school buses safe and well-maintained?

Ans: Yes. Our buses are equipped with all the safety measures, including GPS, CCTV, and first-aid kits (or given by the school) and undergo regular safety inspections and maintenance checks.

27. Do the school buses have trained staff?

Ans: Yes, each bus is accompanied by a trained driver and a female bus attendant to ensure student safety and supervision. (Change based on school)

28. Who do I contact for transportation-related queries or issues?

Ans: For any transportation-related queries or issues, you can reach out to our Transport Coordinator at [Phone Number] or email [Email Address].

columns.title: Sports Content Section
columns.content:
Fueling Dreams Beyond the Classroom

At DPS Saharanpur, we proudly participate in inter-school, district, state, and national-level sports competitions, fostering a culture of healthy competition and teamwork. We believe in developing champions who excel in both academics and athletics.

Strength in Motion, Discipline in Action
Our campus includes top-notch facilities such as a football ground, basketball court, swimming pool, indoor games room, shooting range, and more — all designed to inspire passion, discipline, and sportsmanship among students.

sections.title: Sports Section 2
sections.content:
Sports Programs & Participation:
  • Inter-School Sports – We proudly participate in inter-school sports competitions, fostering a culture of healthy competition and teamwork among our students. Competing with the Best Our students compete against top schools in the area, encouraging healthy competition and promoting sportsmanship. Developing Champions We focus on developing well-rounded individuals who excel not only in academics but also in sports, promoting physical fitness, teamwork, and discipline.
  • District-Level Sports – Our school is committed to promoting sports excellence at the district level. We offer a range of sports programs and initiatives, including Football, Cricket, Swimming, Basketball, Shooting, Archery, Badminton, Athletics and many more. Achievements Our students have consistently demonstrated outstanding performance in district-level sports competitions, winning medals and awards in various events. Opportunities We provide opportunities for students to participate in intra-school and inter-school sports competitions, helping them develop their skills, teamwork, and sportsmanship.
  • State-Level Sports – Our school's talented athletes have made us proud by participating in state-level sports competitions. With dedication and hard work, they've showcased their skills in various sports, bringing honor to our school. Representing with Pride Our students represent our school with pride, demonstrating exceptional teamwork, sportsmanship, and a winning spirit. Striving for Excellence We continue to nurture and support our athletes, striving for excellence in state-level sports competitions.
  • National-Level Sports – Our school's exceptional athletes have taken their talents to the national stage, representing our state and school with pride. With unwavering dedication and perseverance, they've showcased their skills in various sports, bringing glory to our institution. Shining on the National Platform Our students have demonstrated remarkable sportsmanship, teamwork, and a winning spirit, making us proud and inspiring others to follow in their footsteps.

Facilities:
  • Football Ground – Our school's football ground provides a fantastic platform for students to develop their skills and passion for the sport. With a well-maintained field and necessary facilities, our ground hosts various matches, tournaments, and training sessions, fostering a spirit of teamwork and sportsmanship among our students.
  • Basketball Court – Our school's basketball court is a hub for action, excitement, and teamwork. With a well-maintained court and necessary facilities, our students develop their skills, compete in tournaments, and showcase their passion for the game. A great place to build camaraderie, discipline, and a winning spirit!
  • Swimming Pool – Our school's swimming pool provides a safe and supportive environment for students to learn and excel in swimming. With proper facilities and expert guidance, our pool hosts swimming classes, training sessions, and competitions, helping students develop their aquatic skills and build confidence.
  • Indoor Games Room – Our school's indoor games room is a hub for fun and friendly competition. Equipped with facilities for games like table tennis, carrom, and chess, it provides students with opportunities to develop their strategic thinking, hand-eye coordination, and social skills in a relaxed and engaging environment.
  • Shooting & Archery Range – Our school's state-of-the-art shooting range and archery facilities provide students with a unique opportunity to develop their marksmanship and archery skills. sections.content_heading: Language Skill Development

sections.title: Language Skill Development Section
sections.content:
At Delhi Public School, Saharanpur, we recognize that language is a key to culture, communication, and cognitive development. Our language programs are thoughtfully designed to help students develop strong proficiency, cultural appreciation, and effective communication skills in Hindi, Urdu, and Sanskrit.

 Hindi

As the national language, Hindi holds a special place in our curriculum. We emphasize comprehensive language skills including reading, writing, speaking, and listening. Our approach integrates grammar, vocabulary, and literature, enabling students to connect with rich cultural heritage and contemporary usage alike.

Urdu

Urdu is nurtured as a language of poetry, history, and artistic expression. We provide students with opportunities to learn the script, develop conversational fluency, and explore classic and modern literary works. This helps broaden their cultural understanding and enhances their appreciation of linguistic beauty.

Sanskrit

As an ancient language and the foundation of many Indian languages, Sanskrit is taught to deepen students’ understanding of classical texts, philosophy, and linguistic roots. Our Sanskrit curriculum promotes analytical thinking and fosters respect for India’s intellectual traditions. Through dedicated instruction and engaging activities, DPS Saharanpur ensures that students not only master these languages but also appreciate their cultural significance, enriching their overall educational experience.

data.title: Process Saharanpur
data.description:
Thank you for choosing DPS Saharanpur !

Embarking on the journey to join DPS Saharanpur is a thoughtful process that ensures the right fit for your child’s educational experience. Our admission process is designed to be comprehensive and transparent, providing families with a clear pathway to enrolment.
